texto.es: Nos cuentas qué quieres limpiar (alfombra, tapicería o tile) y te orientamos de inmediato.
texto.en: Tell us what you want cleaned, carpet, upholstery or tile, and we will point you in the right direction right away.

texto.es: Vemos el tipo de material y las manchas reales antes de hablar de precio.
texto.en: We look at the material and the real stains before talking price.

texto.es: Te damos un precio claro antes de empezar, sin cargos escondidos ni sorpresas a mitad de trabajo.
texto.en: We give you a clear price before starting, no hidden charges, no mid-job surprises.

texto.es: Limpiamos con equipo profesional de vapor con el mismo cuidado que ves en nuestras fotos, y dejamos todo listo para usarse.
texto.en: We clean with professional steam equipment with the same care you see in our photos, and leave everything ready to use.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el area y el estado real de la superficie. Llamanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the real area and condition of the surface. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Limpieza profunda a vapor de alfombras con manchas, olores de mascota y suciedad acumulada.
texto.en: Deep steam cleaning of carpets with stains, pet odors and built-up dirt.

texto.es: Limpieza y sellado de pisos de tile y grout para devolverles su apariencia original.
texto.en: Cleaning and sealing of tile and grout floors to restore their original look.

texto.es: Limpieza a vapor de sillones, sofás y sillas con productos amigables con niños y mascotas.
texto.en: Steam cleaning of recliners, sofas and chairs with pet and kid-friendly products.

texto.es: Desinfección electrostática y limpieza de alfombras de area, certificados IICRC.
texto.en: Electrostatic disinfecting and area rug cleaning, IICRC certified.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Llamanos igual: la mayoría de nuestros trabajos empiezan como una consulta puntual.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you need? Call us anyway: most of our jobs start out as a quick question.

items.quote: Had Denis come out to treat Berber carpet that had a ton of pet stains and odor. He did an amazing job and the carpet looks and smells brand new! This is after Stanley steamer came out, cleaned the carpet, didn't remove any stains and odor and said it couldn't be done. I am so thrilled with Denis quality of work! Thank you so much!

Dennis was very personable, knowledgeable and professional. He did a great job steam cleaning my carpet. I inquired about getting my tile and grout cleaned and sealed. I received a good quote and will be calling to schedule an appointment. Great job!

I would recommend 100%. We have had to schedule a few different things unexpectedly and Denis was always responsive and always fit us in the schedule. We could not be happier with the customer service and the quality of work. We had to have a recliner cleaned, porch cleaned, and carpets. All areas look fantastic. Thank you!!!
